terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 1)
explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 32. Timing (strongly positive at D1, saturated near -1 at GO, rising from -0.66 to +0.17 at D2 across the episode) explains R^2 0.85; GO has essentially no residual. Beyond timing: at D1 it is raised by a rewarded previous trial (+0.23) and pushed strongly down after an unrewarded trial that reached S1 (-0.58); unrewarded S2 is near baseline. At D2 it encodes the current trial: higher when S2 is reached (+0.32) and when a2 was chosen (+0.29), so a2->S2 is highest and a1->S1 lowest; it is further lowered when the previous trial was rewarded (-0.20) or the previous choice was a1 (-0.29). All terms are observed at that step (action/state known at D2). The trial before (reward two back) adds little (~0.002). 6 terms: dev R^2 beyond timing 0.79 vs all-cues ceiling 0.85 (all observed 0.83).

issues: Minor: the D2 effects are not purely additive. Adding (phase==D2)*(state==S2)*(action==2) and (phase==D2)*(prev_reward==1)*(prev_state==S1) raises test R^2 from 0.787 to 0.803. That is a small refinement, not a missing error class.
Minor: the D2 and D1 effects get somewhat larger later in the episode. Interactions with ep_dec give test R^2 of 0.800 (D2 terms) and 0.799 (D1 terms), up from 0.787.

Misses shows only modest systematic errors, all under 0.2. The largest is D2 after a1 S2 r, under-predicted by 0.199. D2 after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by 0.174. Some of the worst windows are D1 steps after an unrewarded S2 trial that followed unrewarded S1 trials: the actual value is near -0.5 against a predicted value near +0.07. However, a term for two-back unrewarded S1 adds only 0.0004 to test R^2.

Every claim checks out against the profile. D1 residuals are about +0.15 to +0.21 after rewarded trials, about -0.59 / -0.66 after unrewarded S1 trials, and -0.01 / -0.10 after unrewarded S2 trials. D2 residuals by this choice x state are a1->S1 -0.45 and a2->S2 +0.44. Dropping either the prev_reward or the prev_action term at D2 costs 0.04-0.07 test R^2. Using the upcoming choice at D1 (a future variable) adds only about 0.003. The reported test R^2 of 0.787 matches the rerun, against an observed-only ceiling of 0.83.
